meta.name: x-cpu
meta.description:
Display CPU information and detect system endianness.
Shows model, cores, frequency, vendor, cache size.

**Dependency**: This is an x-cmd module. Install x-cmd first (see x-cmd skill for installation options).
see x-cmd skill for installation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查看 CPU 信息与系统字节序
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查看 CPU 型号、核心数、频率等基本信息。
copy.tagline_en: Display CPU info and detect system endianness
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check CPU model, cores, frequency, and endianness.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以显示 CPU 的型号、核心数、频率、厂商和缓存大小，还能检测系统是大端序还是小端序。
howto.when: 当用户要求查看 CPU 信息或检测字节序时触发。

say.text: 显示我的 CPU 信息。
say.note: Claude 会输出 CPU 型号、核心数等详情。

say.text: 检测系统是大端还是小端。
say.note: Claude 会返回 l（小端）或 b（大端）。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can display CPU details such as model, cores, frequency, vendor, and cache size, and detect whether the system is little-endian or big-endian.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to show CPU information or detect endianness.

say_en.note: Claude will output CPU model, cores, etc.

say_en.text: Check if the system is little or big endian.
say_en.note: Claude will return l (little) or b (big).
